name: loom-workspace
description: Loom-managed workspace with AI development orchestration

scripts.check:ci: t=$(mktemp) || exit 1; git ls-files -z ':(glob)tests/**/*.py' > "$t" || { echo 'git ls-files failed' >&2; rm -f "$t"; exit 1; }; [ -s "$t" ] || { echo 'no tracked tests/**/*.py guards found' >&2; rm -f "$t"; exit 1; }; rc=0; xargs -0 -n1 sh -c 'python3 -I "$0" || { echo "$0 failed" >&2; exit 1; }' < "$t" || rc=1; rm -f "$t"; [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] || { echo 'a tests/ guard failed' >&2; exit 1; }
